Diving with W Divers Coron

Find your way into Coron's underwater world.

A wreck-focused visit, a day around the reefs, or a first introduction to scuba: start with the experience you're looking for.

Where are you in your diving journey?

  • I'm a certified diver
  • I'm new to scuba
  • I'm interested in training
  • I'm planning for a group

Explore Coron's wrecks.

Discover the destination's historic underwater structures and talk through suitable diving options for your certification and experience.

Wreck Diving

Take a different route below the surface.

Explore the reef side of Coron and ask about trips that suit your interests and travel dates.

Reef Diving

  • Begin with a conversation, then the basics.

    Find out what an introductory scuba experience involves before deciding on your next step.

    First-Time Divers

  • Build skills for the diving you want to do.

    Share your current level and goals, and ask about suitable training and instructor availability.

    Courses & Training

  • Spend some time above the surface.

    Ask about island-hopping arrangements for your group, including anyone who prefers to stay dry.

    Island Hopping

What should you confirm before booking?

  • Number of dives and approximate day length
  • Suitable sites
  • Equipment and rental charges
  • Boat arrangements
  • Meals and transfers
  • Park or entrance fees
  • Total price and booking terms

These details vary by arrangement. Ask for a clear quotation for your dates.
